name: AutoBot
description: Macro recorder / auto-play bot with an optional anti-death safety net. Never submits progress while active.

safety-net.name: Anti-death safety net (Replay only)
safety-net.description: While replaying, ignore deaths so a tiny desync does not kill the run. Progress is never saved while the bot is active.

show-hitboxes.name: Show hitboxes
show-hitboxes.description: Draw hitboxes (red = hazard, blue = solid, green = orb/pad/portal) and the player's path.
